items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Yeah, Udel Wilson. I remember him. He came from Kansas City. Yeah, he was a tall, brown skin boy. I knew him well.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Udel Wilson. Was that the name of him?
